task_completion.description: Log into the wger application as admin.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The browser shows the wger dashboard or the Django Administration login page followed by the admin index page.

task_completion.description: Navigate to the 'Groups' section within the Django Administration panel.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The URL contains '/admin/auth/group/' or the page header says 'Select group to change' or 'Add group'.
The 'Name' input field in the group creation form contains the text 'Personal Trainers'.

task_completion.description: Assign the three specific exercise permissions: add, change, and view.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Chosen permissions' box contains 'exercises | exercise | Can add exercise', 'exercises | exercise | Can change exercise', and 'exercises | exercise | Can view exercise'.

task_completion.description: Ensure 'Can delete exercise' is NOT assigned.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Chosen permissions' box does NOT contain 'exercises | exercise | Can delete exercise'.
A success message appears (e.g., 'The group "Personal Trainers" was added successfully') or the group appears in the list of groups.

integrity.description: The agent used the web interface rather than executing database commands in a terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse movements, clicks, and typing within the browser window, not just terminal output.

integrity.description: The agent navigated through the Django admin menus to reach the group settings.
integrity.visual_evidence: Sequential screenshots show the transition from the admin home page to the Auth/Groups section.

integrity.description: The agent did not run a python script to bypass the UI.
integrity.visual_evidence: The terminal (if visible) does not show the execution of scripts like 'manage.py shell' or custom SQL/ORM scripts.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The group name must be exactly 'Personal Trainers'. The required permissions are 'exercises | exercise | Can add exercise', 'exercises | exercise | Can change exercise', and 'exercises | exercise | Can view exercise'. The permission 'exercises | exercise | Can delete exercise' must be absent. There should be exactly 3 permissions in the 'Chosen permissions' list.
